title: The TRUTH About Organic Food & Is It Worth It? | Dr. Mindy Pelz
summary: Fasting coach argues pesticides are cancer-causing estrogen mimics and glyphosate wrecks the gut, so organic is worth the cost, using the Dirty Dozen when money is tight.

assertions.quote: they are spraying chemicals on our food that are cancer-causing
they become toxic estrogen which contributes to hormonal cancers like breast cancer

verdicts.note: Some pesticides show endocrine activity in lab studies, but dietary residue levels have not been shown to cause breast or other hormonal cancers.

Breast cancer was slightly higher (RR 1.09) among women who usually ate organic, and the authors say this does not support lower pesticide exposure reducing breast cancer and that later studies did not confirm early pesticide-breast cancer links.

assertions.quote: a food that has technically not been sprayed
you might decide that the dirty dozen have to be organic but the Clean 15 may not
in my book Organics worth it it's absolutely worth it

verdicts.note: On the pesticide rationale alone, substituting organic for conventional Dirty Dozen produce showed no measurable consumer health benefit because conventional exposures were negligible; nutrition and other reasons not assessed.

assertions.quote: maybe you want to prevent a chronic disease then yes we want to be able to eat organic
